maddeler.e:
نأتنس (form VIII)
# نَأْتَنِسُ (naʔtanisu) /naʔ.ta.ni.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# نَأْتَنِسَ (naʔtanisa) /naʔ.ta.ni.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
# نَأْتَنِسْ (naʔtanis) /naʔ.ta.nis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِئْتَنَسَ (iʔtanasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
